verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say you can create deposit accounts through its platform APIs, held in FBO structures with partner banks ([unit-docs-1], [unit-docs-11], [unit-docs-26], [unit-docs-6]). The rest of the story is unevidenced: nothing shows a programmatic application-to-active flow, FDIC insurance coverage, or a sandbox that mirrors production, and probes found no OpenAPI spec ([unit-probe-3]). missing for 10: documented programmatic application/KYC-to-active account flow, explicit FDIC/deposit-insurance coverage, sandbox environment with production parity, in-depth API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
